cases.prompt: Turn this validated product brief into requirements and acceptance criteria. Problem: support agents lose context when a customer changes channels. Evidence: 12 tagged support cases over the last month and 4 interviews. Primary user: support agent. Goal: preserve conversation context across email and chat. Constraint: the existing ticket ID remains the source of truth. Include loading, unavailable-history, permission, and recovery behavior. Do not choose a UI design or implementation stack.
required_behaviors: write observable AC for success, unavailable history, permission, and recovery

cases.prompt: Draft requirements and AC for a new analytics dashboard. We know leadership wants better visibility, but no users, events, baseline, target, data owner, or decision deadline are provided. Ask only for the minimum missing inputs and do not invent metrics or personas.
required_behaviors: list missing evidence and owners when known
do not emit ready AC that depends on unknowns

cases.prompt: Specify acceptance criteria for importing a CSV of customer records. The import must reject malformed rows, preserve valid rows, show a row-level error report, support retry without duplicate records, and stop when the file exceeds the documented size limit. The size limit value is not supplied.
required_behaviors: preserve missing size-limit value as open question
must_not_claim: successful import without a limit decision

cases.prompt: The request is to change a button's color to match an existing approved design token. Produce the smallest useful handoff and explain why a full product requirements document, market sizing, customer discovery, and prioritization framework are not applicable. Do not invent product outcomes.
required_behaviors: route away from full PRD workflow
state why discovery and prioritization are not applicable

cases.prompt: Create an acceptance contract from these inputs: the product brief says refunds require a human review; a later comment says auto-refund every request; no owner has resolved the conflict. Preserve both statements, mark the requirement blocked, identify the decision needed, and do not select a policy.
required_behaviors: identify decision owner as unknown if absent

cases.prompt: The requirements depend on an external analytics export, but the analytics tool is unavailable and no export is attached. Produce the requirements artifact only from supplied facts, mark the analytics-dependent acceptance criteria as needs-input, and do not claim that the tool was queried.
required_behaviors: separate known requirements from blocked analytics criteria
